mapper.select: SELECT ci.ingredient_id AS ingredientId, ci.cocktail_id AS cocktailId, p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, c.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM cocktail_ingredients ci LEFT JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.id -- 품목 테이블과 조인 LEFT JOIN categories c ON ci.category_id = c.category_id; -- 카테고리 테이블과 조인
